name: bible-encyclopedia
description: Arabic, English, and Spanish offline Bible encyclopedia

scripts.validate:es: node validate-spanish-bible.js && node validate-english-encyclopedia.js --lang=es && node validate-spanish-localization.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:bundle: node verify-release-signing.js && npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && cap open ios
